Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on what went wrong with Weights & Biases at a company: "we had a very hard time having 'company dashboards' and getting people to have consistent views into ongoing experiments that they understood. charts were always moving around, the step function would hcange, etc". Design input, not a decided rule: Etude already defines an experiment's page in code (`report()` in the experiment file, against declared clocks). Consider what the live and shared views must do so that everyone opening an experiment sees the same charts in the same order on the same clock, and where personal exploration goes so it does not change what others see.
